# Unity Game Simulation Match-3 sample scope (R01)

The owner’s R06 implementation instruction explicitly authorizes use of selected Unity-Technologies/Game-Simulation-Match-3-Sample source for this Windows-local Factory authoring prototype. The imported source remains attributed to its upstream repository and governed by the Unity Companion License; see `LICENSE.md`, `NOTICE.md`, and `source-manifest.json` for the exact notice and pinned source revision.

This note records implementation scope only. It is not legal advice and does not resolve the separate MATCH3_ENGINE tracker’s earlier license/release gate. The local prototype preserves the original notices and does not import sample art or sound. Distribution of the sample code as a production-game runtime, commercial asset redistribution, or a release claim remains blocked until the cross-project owner decision and license review are reconciled. The reference assembly is excluded from Factory player builds; it is available only to the local editor and sample integration tests.

R01 status: source attribution retained; local editor/sample test scope documented; production distribution/release gate remains open.
